one_liner: CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing with an extensive REST/SOAP/Bulk API surface.

auth.notes: Salesforce docs site returned 403 to WebFetch (bot-blocked), so no verbatim quote could be captured; WebSearch summaries consistently describe OAuth 2.0 via Connected Apps / External Client Apps as the auth mechanism, with the resulting access token used as a bearer token.

access.notes: Free Developer Edition org available for signup, capped at 15,000 API requests/day per WebSearch summary of Salesforce docs; direct verbatim quote unavailable because the docs site blocked WebFetch (403). A third party building an app that connects to OTHER customers' orgs does so per-org via OAuth consent at install time (not a separate marketplace review unless listed on AppExchange), so extra_gate is treated as none rather than app_review.

api.evidence_quote: The Salesforce DX MCP Server is a specialized Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation designed to facilitate seamless interaction between large language models (LLMs) and Salesforce orgs.
api.notes: Salesforce's REST API is resource/object based (SObject API covers arbitrary custom + standard objects) so a fixed endpoint count doesn't apply cleanly; classified broad given breadth of Metadata, Bulk, REST, and Connect APIs. Official MCP server is salesforcecli/mcp (Salesforce DX MCP Server), oriented at org development/admin tasks via CLI auth rather than being a generic data-API MCP.

verdict.rationale: Free Developer Edition org plus OAuth2 connected-app flow gives a third party a working, self-serve credential against a broad REST API with an official MCP server.
